title: The transported etale unit is natural on opens
statement: Let $X$ and $Z$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $i:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Let $F$ be a sheaf of sets on $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets]. Write $b_i:X_{\Et}\to Z_{\Et}$ for base change, $i^*F$ for its sheaf inverse image with adjunction unit $\eta^{\Et}$ [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-functor-sheaf-pullback-adjunction], and $j_X,j_Z$ for the open-subscheme inclusion functors. Suppose $A$ and $G$ are topological sheaves of sets on $X$ and $Z$, with presheaf isomorphisms $e_X:A\cong F\circ j_X$ and $e_Z:G\cong (i^*F)\circ j_Z$. For each open $W\subseteq X$, choose an isomorphism $a_W:j_Z(i^{-1}W)\cong b_i(j_X(W))$ of etale $Z$-schemes whose first pullback projection is the restricted morphism $i|_W:i^{-1}W\to W$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Define the function $r_W:A(W)\to G(i^{-1}W)$ by $r_W(s)=e_Z^{-1}((i^*F)(a_W)(\eta^{\Et}_{j_X(W)}(e_X(s))))$, where $(i^*F)(a_W)$ denotes contravariant restriction along the hom of $a_W$. Then there exists a morphism of topological sheaves $\alpha:A\to i_*G$ [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image] with $\alpha_W(s)=r_W(s)$ for every open $W\subseteq X$ and every $s\in A(W)$.

proof.text: For an inclusion of opens, compare the two morphisms from the restricted preimage open to the base-changed larger open. Their first projections agree by the assumed projection equation and naturality of the restricted scheme morphism. Their second projections agree since the isomorphisms are over Z. Pullback uniqueness proves the comparison square commutes.

Compose the presheaf comparison eX, the etale unit restricted to opens, contravariant restriction by a, and the comparison eZ inverse. Naturality of the unit and both comparisons, and the square just proved, show that the composite components form a natural transformation. Regard it as a sheaf morphism; the component formula is definitional.
